title: Getting Started: Your First Five Moves in Debt Payoff Plan
summary: Start debt payoff plan this week with five concrete moves.
body:
Don't try to do everything. Do these five, in order:

1. List all debts with balances and APRs
2. Pick avalanche or snowball
3. Pay minimums on all; attack one with extra
4. Automate the extra payment
5. Roll freed payments into the next debt

Five moves, one week. Momentum beats perfection — the rest of this guide builds on exactly this start.

title: Debt Payoff Plan Beginner FAQ
summary: Straight answers to the most common debt payoff plan questions.
body:
Q: Avalanche or snowball?
A: Avalanche is cheaper; snowball sticks better. Pick the one you'll follow.

Q: Should I invest instead?
A: Pay anything above ~7% APR before investing.

Q: Consolidation loan?
A: Only if the rate is lower AND you stop new borrowing.

Still stuck? Start with record 2 of this guide and do the first move today.
